translations.web: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.
translations.bsb: Here is the sea, vast and wide, teeming with creatures beyond number, living things both great and small.
translations.kjv: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
translations.asv: Yonder is the sea, great and wide, Wherein are things creeping innumerable, Both small and great beasts.
